overview.name: InputEmail - General
overview.description:
This scenario verifies inputEmail command execution with highlight and target variable extraction.
Test flow: 1. Include web login steps. 2. Generate random 6-digit OTP code. 3. Send verification email via SMTP containing the OTP. 4. Navigate to UI Elements page. 5. Fetch OTP from mailbox and type it into input field using inputEmail. 6. Verify input element value matches sent OTP code. 7. Verify targetVariable matches sent OTP code.
This scenario validates: - email mailbox connection and regex extraction - typing into UI element - highlight=true behavior - targetVariable assignment
